meta.title: SAP MM (Purchase Requisition): on failure — PR held in 'Sync Pending' state
gaps: Configure the SAP MM bidirectional integration and its CONF-INT-001 sync-mode dependency.
Make the external SAP/RFC/API endpoint fail or become unreachable.
Approve a Procol purchase requisition and cause the resulting purchase order synchronization to SAP.
Verify the PR is held in Sync Pending through integration state, alert, retry record, or log evidence, and verify nothing was silently dropped.
